A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (22 January 2023). Its words are Decipher's errata from the Glossary Supplement (29 January 2002) with one change: a comma is added after “creature” (“creature, or vehicle”).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:EJP-D-dengarwithblastercarbine-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Dengar With Blaster Carbine (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels: sharper art and frame, lore and game text set again, and the mark “D-E1” in place of “E”. The game text reads: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Permanent weapon is •Dengar’s Blaster Carbine (may target a character, creature, or vehicle for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 &gt; defense value; may be fired twice per battle).” (a comma is added after “creature” (“creature, or vehicle”)).

The whole 2018 image and the whole D-E1 image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
